name_en: Nattojiru — a winter miso soup thickened with mashed fermented soybeans
summary_ja: すり鉢で粒が見えなくなるまで潰した納豆でとろみをつけ、いもがらや山菜、豆腐と一緒に味噌仕立てで煮る冬の汁。とろみのぶん冷めにくく、雪深い山形で無病息災を願う七草の頃に食べられてきたという。
summary_en: Fermented soybeans are ground smooth in a mortar to thicken a miso soup filled with dried taro-stem, wild greens, and tofu. The thickened broth holds its heat, and in snowbound Yamagata it is said to be eaten around the seven-herb season as a wish for good health.
source_title: 納豆汁 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Dongarajiru (kandarajiru) — a miso soup made from whole winter cod, bones and all
summary_ja: 寒の時季にとれる寒ダラを頭から内臓まで余さず味噌仕立ての汁にする、庄内の漁師料理が起こりとされる冬の一杯。あぶらわたと呼ぶ肝のこくが決め手で、ねぎは入れず岩のりだけを添えるのが本来という。
summary_en: Winter cod caught in the coldest weeks goes into a miso soup head to tail, innards included — said to trace back to fishermen's cooking on the Shonai coast. The liver's richness carries the flavor, and the traditional way adds only a scrap of rock nori, no scallion.
source_title: どんがら汁／寒鱈汁 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Imoni — a riverside autumn hot pot of taro and beef simmered together
summary_ja: 里芋と牛肉、こんにゃく、ねぎを醤油味で煮込む秋の鍋で、最上川舟運の船頭が河原で棒ダラと里芋を煮て待ち時間を過ごしたのが始まりと伝わる。庄内側では豚肉と味噌仕立てに変わるなど地域差も大きい。
summary_en: Taro, beef, konnyaku, and scallion simmer together in a soy-based autumn hot pot said to trace to boatmen on the Mogami River, who cooked taro and dried cod on the riverbank while waiting out the delays of cargo transport. On the Shonai coast the same dish turns to pork and miso.
source_title: 芋煮 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Toyama kabu no kasujiru — a sake-lees soup built on Yonezawa's firm heirloom turnip
summary_ja: 煮崩れしにくい米沢の伝統野菜「遠山かぶ」と、大豆を木づちで打って平たくした「打ち豆」を味噌汁仕立てにし、仕上げに酒粕を加えてまろやかにする冬の汁。上杉鷹山の産業振興策で栽培が広まったと伝わる。
summary_en: Toyama turnip, a Yonezawa heirloom vegetable firm enough to hold its shape, and uchimame — soybeans flattened with a wooden mallet — go into a miso soup finished with sake lees for a mellow winter dish. Cultivation is said to have spread under lord Uesugi Yozan's push to build up local industry.
source_title: 遠山かぶの粕汁 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Shio kujira jiru — new potatoes and salted whale blubber simmered for summer stamina
summary_ja: 皮付きの鯨の脂身を塩漬けにした塩くじらと新じゃがいも、夏野菜を一緒に煮る内陸の暑気払い料理。動物性たんぱく源が乏しかった山間部で夏を乗り切るために生まれたとされ、村山地域では「いるか汁」とも呼ぶという。
summary_en: Salted whale blubber, skin still on, is simmered with new potatoes and summer vegetables — a heat-battling dish of inland Yamagata. It is said to have taken shape in mountain areas short on animal protein, and in the Murayama area it also goes by the name iruka-jiru.
source_title: 塩くじら汁 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Mosojiru — a miso soup built on freshly dug moso bamboo shoots
summary_ja: その日の朝に掘りたての孟宗竹のたけのこを厚揚げやしいたけと一緒に煮て、酒粕と味噌で仕立てる鶴岡の初夏の汁。鶴岡市湯田川温泉周辺は粘土質の赤土が良質な孟宗を育てるとされ、産地として知られている。
summary_en: Moso bamboo shoots dug that same morning are simmered with fried tofu and shiitake, finished with sake lees and miso — an early-summer soup of Tsuruoka. The clay-rich red soil around Yudagawa Onsen in Tsuruoka is said to grow especially good shoots, and the area is known as a source.
source_title: 孟宗汁 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
